dowager.reference_transcript: I have always found that the people most determined to speak plainly are those with the least to say. One does admire the confidence, if not the content. Really, I cannot fathom why people are so very startled to find that reality fails to conform to their expectations. It does so rather reliably. Do they genuinely believe that enthusiasm compensates for competence? How very touching. And how entirely mistaken.
dowager.description: Elderly aristocratic British lady. Zero-shot cloned from ElevenLabs reference.

lincoln.reference_transcript: I have held this Union together while half of it was actively trying to kill the other half. I did it without proper sleep, adequate generals, or a single kind word from the press. You cannot seem to hold a simple plan together for one afternoon. My hat is taller and considerably better organized than your strategy.
lincoln.description: High-pitched reedy tenor, Kentucky frontier accent. Zero-shot cloned from ElevenLabs reference.

mao.reference_transcript: You call that an army? I crossed twenty-four mountain ranges and twenty rivers in bare feet, outran the entire Kuomintang, and still had time to write poetry. You have every advantage I was denied and you are losing to barbarians. The peasants of Hunan had more tactical sense than this.
mao.description: Hunanese-accented male, deliberate cadence, chain-smoker roughness. From ElevenLabs website generation.

washington.reference_transcript: I have faced British regulars, frozen rivers, and the Continental Congress — simultaneously, and in worse weather than this. So you will forgive me if your formation fails to inspire alarm. I have drilled Virginia militia with more instinct than this. Straighten that line. We have a republic to build. Today.
washington.description: Deep commanding baritone, Virginia planter accent. Zero-shot cloned from ElevenLabs reference.
